package argojob

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	wfv1 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/pkg/apis/workflow/v1alpha1"
)

// #1564 recapture inputs: exactly what the retained fixture regressions compare
// (current Build plus the documented historical scheduling and measurement
// reconstruction against each set's own frozen input).
func TestExportKubeconfigControllerInputs(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("OBERTH_PROOF_ROOT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("OBERTH_PROOF_ROOT unset")
	}
	write := func(dir, name string, wf *wfv1.Workflow) {
		t.Helper()
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(wf, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, dir, name), data, 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	old := func(dir, name string) *wfv1.Workflow {
		t.Helper()
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", dir, name))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var wf wfv1.Workflow
		if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &wf); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return &wf
	}
	for _, shape := range []string{"dedicated-tools", "none", "container", "script", "containerset", "sidecars", "inline-dag", "inline-steps"} {
		captured := old("isolation-argo4.0.8", shape+"-workflow.json")
		r := isolationControllerRequest(t, shape)
		if err := recoverHelperStorage(captured, &r); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		wf, err := Build(testConfig(), r)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		historicalSchedulingInput(t, wf, true)
		historicalMeasurementInput(t, wf, captured)
		write("isolation", shape+"-workflow.json", wf)
	}
	for _, shape := range wifControllerShapes {
		captured := old("wif-argo4.0.8", shape+"-workflow.json")
		c, r := wifControllerInput(t, shape)
		if err := recoverHelperStorage(captured, &r); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		wf, err := Build(c, r)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		historicalSchedulingInput(t, wf, true)
		historicalMeasurementInput(t, wf, captured)
		write("wif", shape+"-workflow.json", wf)
	}
	for _, shape := range []string{"container", "script"} {
		wf := nonrootBuiltWithHelperPolicy(t, shape == "script", "128Mi", legacyHelperStoragePolicy)
		historicalSchedulingInput(t, wf, false)
		historicalMeasurementInput(t, wf, old("nonroot-argo4.0.8", shape+"-persisted-workflow.json"))
		write("nonroot", shape+".json", wf)
	}
}
